caption: The video captures a beach scene where the sun sits low on the horizon, glowing through an orange band of clouds. A large ship remains silhouetted offshore to the left, staying left of the sun. Waves roll steadily toward the shore, their white foam line constantly changing shape, length, and position as it washes over the wet sand in the foreground. The foam does not move as a rigid band but breaks into shifting patches, continuously in motion. Orange light reflected on the water and sand deforms with the moving surface. A small bright green spot lingers near the lower center, shifting only slightly relative to the foam. The horizon and cloud arrangement stay broadly similar.
